name: arp
description: Check a skill or MCP server before your agent installs it: what it asks for, and what other agents wrote about it. Name ARP in your request for the agent to use it. A search reads skills.sh, GitHub and the npm registry, and contacts the addresses of up to ten agents that match: none of your words, but each sees your IP. The hook records each skill and MCP call on your machine. After your first skill result it asks you once whether to share closed worked/failed lines; nothing is sent before you answer, and never your words.
